mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS taskId, t.total_host_count AS totalHostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_task_host h WHERE h.task_id = t.id AND h.status = 'FINISHED') AS finishedHostCount, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.compliance_rate), 2) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = t.id) AS avgComplianceRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s.fail_count = 0) AS passHostCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = t.id AND s.fail_count > 0) AS failHostCount FROM baseline_task t WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

SELECT s.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, s.compliance_rate AS complianceRate, s.fail_count AS failRuleCount FROM baseline_summary s LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = s.host_id WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} AND s.fail_count > 0 ORDER BY s.fail_count DESC, s.host_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_summary s WHERE s.task_id = #{taskId} AND s.fail_count > 0

SELECT id AS id, rule_code AS ruleCode, rule_name AS ruleName, category AS category, severity AS severity FROM baseline_rule WHERE enabled = 1 AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND (rule_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rule_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT r.id AS resultId, r.rule_id AS ruleId, ru.rule_name AS ruleName, ru.category AS category, r.check_key AS checkKey, r.expected_value AS expectedValue, r.actual_value AS actualValue, r.evidence AS evidence, r.status AS status, ru.remediation_type AS remediationType, r.remediation_status AS remediationStatus, r.scan_time AS scanTime FROM baseline_result r LEFT JOIN baseline_rule ru ON ru.id = r.rule_id WHERE r.host_id = #{hostId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM baseline_result newer WHERE newer.host_id = r.host_id AND newer.rule_id = r.rule_id AND COALESCE(newer.check_key, '') = COALESCE(r.check_key, '') AND ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') > COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') OR ( COALESCE(newer.scan_time, '1970-01-01') = COALESCE(r.scan_time, '1970-01-01') AND newer.id > r.id ) ) )
AND r.status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR')
ORDER BY (r.status = 'PASS') ASC, r.id ASC
